# @mongez/react-helmet

> React adapter for `@mongez/dom`'s metadata module. A single `<Helmet>` component sets the document title (with optional app-name suffix), description, keywords, Open Graph / Twitter meta, canonical URL, favicon, and `<html>` attributes — declarative, with cleanup on unmount.

Every export ships from the package root. The component is effect-only (returns `null`), so it can be dropped at any depth in a tree.

## Quick rules

1. **One default export**: `import Helmet from "@mongez/react-helmet"`. Named exports: `setHelmetConfigurations`, `getHelmetConfigurations`, `getHelmetConfig`, and the `HelmetProps` / `HelmetConfigurations` types.
2. **Only `title` is required**. Every other prop falls back to the config or simply isn't touched.
3. **The component returns `null`** — all writes happen in effects on the real `document.head` / `document.documentElement`.
4. **Browser-only**: the module accesses `document` at import time. Wrap in a `"use client"` boundary (Next.js App Router) or a `dynamic(..., { ssr: false })` import (Pages Router / Remix).
5. **Under the hood it's `@mongez/dom`**: `setTitle`, `setDescription`, `setKeywords`, `setImage`, `setCanonicalUrl`, `setHTMLAttributes`. If you need finer-grained control outside React, use `@mongez/dom` directly.
